problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of six specialized transport vehicles to deliver six distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 6.169 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 11.723 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 16.161 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 11.745 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 12.633 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 17.102 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle type is detailed below:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 requires 1.469 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.924 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.496 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.862 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.87 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.343 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.893 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.655 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.787 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.592 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.297 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.363 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 requires 0.254 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.22 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.651 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.572 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.896 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.596 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.326 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.901 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.784 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.269 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.038 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.694 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 requires 0.428 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.479 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.791 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.244 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.053 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.139 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.275 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.219 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.825 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.208 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.543 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.399 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 1 cannot surpass 180.384
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 2 cannot surpass 150.047
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 3 cannot surpass 184.055
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 4 cannot surpass 149.695
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 5 cannot surpass 164.356
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 6 cannot surpass 160.858

Given the necessity to ensure that the total handling time for each vehicle—Vehicle 1, Vehicle 2, Vehicle 3, Vehicle 4, Vehicle 5, and Vehicle 6—does not exceed its respective available capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
